reason: Lucide search glyph satisfies the brief on every constraint: 24x24 viewBox on the 24 grid, stroke-width 1.5, currentColor, round caps/joins, no text or logo, and no hardcoded palette colors (so it inherits the neutral baseline token when used). Rendered PNG inspection confirms the actual raster matches spec: at 2x the ring is 3px (1.5px at 24px), the glyph is centered (content bounds ~2.25–21.75 in both axes, optical center 12,12), and nothing is clipped at the canvas edge. The handle path m21 21-4.34-4.34 terminates essentially on the lens circumference (distance ~8.00 vs r=8), so the handle is joined without a gap as the sourceHint requires. Markup is two primitives (one path, one circle) with no fills or embedded raster, making it trivially editable and recolorable. Semantics are unambiguous for a magnifier search/picker trigger. Hard gate passed with no issues; no blocking defects to report.
